source: vqsv6 data/script/db.mid tables 0, 1, 8; formulas from decompiled VQSV_FIX_2.7 game/i.java and game/a.java
confidence: Stat formulas, turn order, damage, crit, element multipliers and skill pools are read directly from decompiled code. Skill status effects (cols 6-9), column 22 semantics beyond the element check, and table 2-7 buffs are not decoded.

rules.damage: max(1, attacker.attack - defender.defense) * skill.power_percent / 100; crit x1.5; element x3 or x0.6; then +-1 jitter, minimum 1
rules.crit_chance_percent: 5 + attacker.speed / 2 (30 base in a special sprite case)
rules.column22_rule: if exactly one side has col22 == 2, only that side's favourable multiplier applies
